author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'rca-task-20260726-171926-remove-anthropic-api-key-dead-code-path' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  scripts/veridian-task-watchdog.py          |  55 ++++++++++++++
 tests/veridian_task_watchdog_dedup_test.py | 118 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 173 insertions(+)
Evidence Recorded: The dedup code itself (rca_already_in_flight(), title-based glob scan over task.yaml, TERMINAL_TASK_STATUSES filter, plus regression tests) is competently written and correctly tested in isolation, but this branch is stale duplicate work that must not be merged: it forked scripts/veridian-task-watchdog.py from the pre-fix version (commit 3af111b, 2026-07-23) and independently reimplements the exact same step_3 RCA-dedup goal that master already solved via a different, more complete mechanism -- PR #110 'Add Server Resource Governor' (commit 4b151ce, merged into master 2026-07-27T07:09:05Z), which added task_identity-based dedup inside resource_governor.submit() and is already running live on the production server. Verified directly (not from self-report): reading /opt/veridian/scripts/veridian-task-watchdog.py shows the live escalate() signature is escalate(task_id, task, signature, dry_run=False) and routes through _governor().submit(), whereas this diff's escalate() is the old 2-arg form (task_id, signature); `git merge-tree` of this branch against current master produces a real <<<<<<< conflict on scripts/veridian-task-watchdog.py at exactly that function. Force-resolving toward this branch would regress two already-shipped master fixes: the governor's task_identity dedup (which also covers FIX_ACTIONS restart/reset paths, not just escalation) and PR #105's fix for escalate()'s hardcoded --repo=claude-control bug. This is the exact NO DUPLICATION/NO COLLISION failure SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md rules 8-9 exist to prevent: the same original stall (task-20260726-171926) spawned at least 6 independent sibling branches attempting this same watchdog fix (this one, fix/watchdog-escalation-cooldown-2026-07-27, worker/task-20260726-175954-rca-task-20260726-171939-..., worker/task-20260726-185117-..., worker/task-20260726-182702-...) plus the winning worker/task-20260727-061625-build-server-resource-governor branch that actually merged. No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff. Issues found: Stale base: forked from pre-governor commit 3af111b, never rebased onto master's already-merged Resource Governor fix (PR #110, commit 4b151ce) for the identical dedup problem.; Confirmed merge conflict against current master on scripts/veridian-task-watchdog.py's escalate() function (verified via git merge-tree, not assumed).; If force-merged, would regress two already-shipped master fixes: governor-based task_identity dedup (broader coverage than this diff's title-glob approach) and the escalate() hardcoded --repo=claude-control fix from PR #105.; Duplicate/uncoordinated work: at least 5 other sibling branches independently attempt the same watchdog RCA-dedup fix from the same original stall incident, violating the dispatch prompt's NO DUPLICATION/NO COLLISION rule (should have been caught by checking existing task/branch state before dispatch).; Recommend: close this branch without merging, and follow up only if the live Resource Governor fix (already in master and in production) turns out to have a real gap the governor doesn't cover -- do not restart from scratch per rule 13's 'never a full restart' guidance.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
